vignette: A young adult with a congenital condition has received all dental care at a children's hospital clinic since infancy. The clinic now says it can no longer see the patient because of the patient's age. The family has not found another dental home.
stem: Which factor most directly accounts for the access barrier this patient is facing?

options.text: A lower overall risk of oral disease in people with special health care needs
Special health care needs being so uncommon that few providers are prepared to treat them
An age limit at the pediatric hospital that stops the patient from continuing care there
A tendency for people with milder conditions to have the most unmet dental needs
Sensory difficulties that reduce the likelihood of oral health problems
